explication: Pro Workflow is an AI-coding workflow system built around persistent correction memory and research wikis. Its main user-to-result loop captures a correction as a learning, stores it in SQLite, then surfaces relevant learnings and wiki material in later sessions. Separate capabilities include wiki authoring and research, hybrid retrieval, multi-LLM deliberation, and skill optimization. The graph combines sampled implementation relationships with README-documented product flows; links for unsampled hooks and wiki internals are limited to those documented flows.
